data.exact_reserve_text: As a result, the claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years. The movement is largely caused by the significant increase in the incurred claims position on individual claims of GBP 16.5m gross and GBP 13.4m net with the Syndicate's consulting actuary, Lane Clark & Peacock (LCP), moving the ultimate claims position out by GBP 26.7m gross and GBP 18.6m net as a consequence.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant increase in incurred claims position on the professional indemnity account driving reserve strengthening.
Materialisation of a number of large losses under the Directors and Officers account leading to an increase in reserves and a large loss loading.

prior_year_events.event_name: Late reporting on personal accident account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Late reporting on the personal accident account caused the incurred position to move adversely.
Consulting actuary added a large loss load, moving the ultimate claims position out significantly.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2016 Syndicate 2526 materially strengthened its claims reserves, driven principally by adverse development on 2013 and prior years largely in professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice exposures. The managing agent and independent claims consultants reviewed outstanding case reserves and posted appropriate technical reserves; the consulting actuary moved the ultimate claims out and added a large loss load. The gross prior-year reserve strengthening in 2016 was GBP 27.071m (14.2% of opening gross claims outstanding).

significant increase in the incurred claims position on individual claims of GBP 16.5m gross and GBP 13.4m net

late reporting on the personal accident account also caused the incurred position to move by some GBP 3.2m

material increase in the incurred claims position
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation ('Changes for prior years' gross column = GBP 27,071k). Some narrative figures quoted in the report are net of reinsurance; where gross figures were available they have been used. LOB allocations of the gross reserve movement are inferred from narrative references to professional indemnity, D&O and medical malpractice (mapped to 'Professional Lines') and specific mention of personal accident; detailed per-LOB gross movements are not provided so LOB amounts are approximate/inferred.
